test: apps/portal/e2e/a11y-keyboard.pw.ts > keyboard-only flow (insertion keeps focus and announces, removal announces)
observed: Intermittent in CI. The spec enters the flow with a raw page.goto, then presses Space on a radio, retrying inside expect(...).toPass. The question text is visible and the radio can be focused, but the awaited POST to /answers never arrives and the test runs out of time at the step that waits for the answer to be recorded. No error is thrown by the keyboard press itself. The maintainers could make it fail on every run by throttling the CPU at rate 6 before the first goto; at normal speed it usually passes.
error: TimeoutError: page.waitForResponse: Timeout exceeded while waiting for the POST /answers response (the answer was never recorded)
environment: Next.js portal; the page is server-rendered with a fallback form and then hydrated by React. Other specs in the repo that enter through shared helpers do not show the problem.
